domains.name: Offense & Combat Stats
domains.summary: Damage, accuracy, crit, speed and other core combat-stat modifiers plus attacker-side pierce flags.

domains.name: Defense & Mitigation
domains.summary: Dodge, protection, HP, damage-taken, reflect and states that make an actor harder to hurt.

domains.name: Resistances
domains.summary: Additive resist to stun, blight, bleed, disease, move, debuff, deathblow and trap.

domains.name: Damage/Heal Over Time
domains.summary: Granting and scaling bleed, blight, burn, stress and heal DoTs (magnitude, duration, decay, spread).

domains.name: Status-Apply Chance
domains.summary: Chance this actor applies bleed, blight, stun, forced-move, debuff or deathblow, plus crit-received chance.

domains.name: Healing
domains.summary: Heal output, heal received, and heal-over-time (regen) power and duration.

domains.name: Stress & Resolve
domains.summary: Stress dealt, stress received, stress heal given/received, resolve checks and XP, and idle/miss stress.

domains.name: States, Guard & Riposte
domains.summary: Riposte, guard, stealth, vampire states and the flags that block or ignore them, plus their durations.

domains.name: Self-Cure & Transfers
domains.summary: Per-turn self-cure of bleed/blight/burn and stealing buffs/debuffs from attackers.

domains.name: Scouting, Surprise & Targeting
domains.summary: Surprise, ambush, scouting chance and random-retarget (confusion) modifiers.

domains.name: Skill Silencing
domains.summary: Disable a whole combat-skill attribute category (heal, stun, bleed, buff, ...) on the actor.

domains.name: Town & Economy
domains.summary: Upgrade discounts, torchlight burn, food, resolve, quirk removal and town-activity side effects.

domains.name: Meta & Lifecycle Flags
domains.summary: Buff/guard/riposte duration scaling and evolution/lifecycle control flags.

domains.name: DLC / Crimson Curse
domains.summary: Crimson Curse (shards, vampire) and Crimson Court / heart-attack specific modifiers.

stats.name: Combat Stat (Flat Add)
stats.summary: Adds a flat value to one of the 8-10 base combat stats named by sub_type. Positive = buff, negative = debuff.
stats.unit_note: Mixed: for 100-scale rating stats (defense_rating/dodge, protection_rating/prot, attack_rating/acc, crit_chance, riposte_on_hit/miss_chance) amount is a FRACTION OF 100 (0.15 = +15 points); for raw-unit stats (damage_low, damage_high, max_hp, speed_rating) amount is RAW UNITS (3 = +3 dmg, 10 = +10 HP, 5 = +5 SPD).

stats.name: Combat Stat (Percent Multiply)
stats.summary: Multiplies one of the base combat stats named by sub_type by a fractional amount. Scales off the target's base, so more valuable on high-base characters.
stats.unit_note: Fraction ~1.0-relative for ALL stats (0.20 = +20%, -0.30 = -30%). For a damage buff author both damage_low and damage_high.

stats.name: Blight DoT (Grant)
stats.summary: Applies or modifies a poison (blight) damage-over-time on HP. Positive amount deals more HP loss per tick.
stats.unit_note: Raw HP lost per tick (per round).

stats.name: Bleed DoT (Grant)
stats.summary: Applies or modifies a bleed damage-over-time on HP. Positive amount deals more HP loss per tick.
stats.unit_note: Raw HP lost per tick (per round).

stats.name: Flat Heal Amount
stats.summary: Flat heal / heal-over-time amount restored to HP. Positive restores health.

stats.name: Healing Output %
stats.summary: Percent-based modifier that scales the HP healing this actor OUTPUTS to others. Positive = stronger heals.

stats.name: Healing Received %
stats.summary: Modifies the amount of HP healing this actor RECEIVES from others. Positive = heals land bigger; negative is a healing-debuff.

stats.name: Stress Dealt %
stats.summary: Modifies the stress DAMAGE this actor deals to targets. Positive = deals more stress.

stats.name: Stress Heal Output %
stats.summary: Modifies the stress HEALING this actor provides to others. Positive = better stress relief given.

stats.name: Resistance
stats.summary: Adds to a specific resistance named by sub_type. Positive = harder to afflict with that status.
stats.unit_note: Fractional +/- to a resist (0.30 = +30% resist). Hero base values live in <class>.info.darkest.

stats.name: Blight Apply Chance
stats.summary: Modifies this actor's chance to APPLY poison (blight) with its attacks. Positive = more blight procs.

stats.name: Bleed Apply Chance
stats.summary: Modifies this actor's chance to APPLY bleed with its attacks. Positive = more bleed procs.

stats.name: Stun Apply Chance
stats.summary: Modifies this actor's chance to APPLY stun with its attacks. Positive = more stuns land.

stats.name: Forced-Move Apply Chance
stats.summary: Modifies this actor's chance to APPLY forced-move (shuffle / knockback / pull) effects. Positive = more moves land.

stats.name: Debuff Apply Chance
stats.summary: Modifies this actor's chance to APPLY debuffs with its skills. Positive = debuffs land more often.

stats.name: Resolve Check %
stats.summary: Modifies the resolve check chance that decides affliction vs virtue at high stress.

stats.name: Resolve XP Bonus %
stats.summary: Modifies resolve XP gained by the hero. Positive = faster leveling.

stats.name: Scouting Chance
stats.summary: Modifies dungeon scouting chance (revealing map / rooms ahead). Positive = scouts more.

stats.name: Remove Negative Quirk Chance
stats.summary: Chance to remove a negative quirk (town / treatment context). Positive = more likely to shed a bad quirk.

stats.name: Food Consumption %
stats.summary: Modifies party food consumption. Negative = eats less food (better).

stats.name: Starving Damage %
stats.summary: Modifies damage taken while starving (failed hunger check). Negative = takes less starve damage (better).

stats.name: Upgrade Discount
stats.summary: Reduces the cost of equipment / skill upgrades in town. Positive = cheaper upgrades.
stats.unit_note: Fractional discount (0–1). Free-form sub_type weapon|armour selects which upgrade line.

stats.name: Party Surprise Chance
stats.summary: Modifies the chance the PARTY is surprised (ambushed). Negative = harder to surprise the party (better).
stats.unit_note: Fractional chance modifier (0–1); negative is beneficial.

stats.name: Monsters Surprise Chance
stats.summary: Modifies the chance MONSTERS are surprised (party gets the surprise). Positive = party ambushes more.

stats.name: Riposte (State)
stats.summary: Grants riposte state, causing the actor to counterattack when attacked.
stats.unit_note: Boolean/duration flag; amount is often 0 or a duration.

stats.name: Guarded (State)
stats.summary: Marks the actor as guarded, redirecting attacks aimed at it to its guardian.

stats.name: Damage Received %
stats.summary: Modifies incoming damage this actor RECEIVES. Positive = vulnerable (takes more); negative = tanky.

stats.name: Stress Heal Received %
stats.summary: Modifies the stress HEALING this actor receives from others. Positive = de-stresses faster.

stats.name: Stress Received %
stats.summary: Modifies the stress DAMAGE this actor receives. Negative = takes less stress (better).
stats.unit_note: Fraction ~1.0-relative modifier; negative is beneficial. Free-form sub_type (mode|hunger|...) can scope it to a context.

stats.name: Vampire (State)
stats.summary: Crimson Curse vampirism state marker.

stats.name: Activity Side-Effect Chance
stats.summary: Modifies the chance of town-activity side effects (e.g. gambling gains/losses of currency or trinkets).

stats.name: Disable Skill Attribute (Silence)
stats.summary: Silences a whole combat-skill attribute category on the actor named by sub_type (e.g. stops it from healing, stunning, bleeding).
stats.unit_note: Flag; the sub_type names which attribute is disabled. Any value outside the exact 12 tokens silently no-ops.

stats.name: Stress DoT (Grant)
stats.summary: Applies or modifies a stress damage-over-time. Positive amount adds stress per tick.

stats.name: Shuffle DoT (Grant)
stats.summary: Applies or modifies a periodic self-shuffle DoT (the actor gets randomly repositioned each tick).

stats.name: Heal DoT / Regen (Grant)
stats.summary: Grants a heal-over-time (regeneration) on HP. Positive amount restores HP per tick.
stats.unit_note: Raw HP restored per tick (per round).

stats.name: Torchlight Burn %
stats.summary: Modifies the rate at which torch light burns down. Negative = torch lasts longer.

stats.name: Quirk Evolution Death Immune
stats.summary: Makes a quirk-evolution effect death-immune (lifecycle control flag).

stats.name: Vampire Evolution Duration
stats.summary: Duration control for vampire (Crimson Curse) evolution.

stats.name: Ambush Chance
stats.summary: Modifies ambush chance (camping / random ambush events).

stats.name: Tag Blocked
stats.summary: Blocks a tag (mark) from being applied to the actor.

stats.name: Ignore Protection
stats.summary: Attacker-side pierce flag: this actor's attacks ignore the target's PROT (armor).

stats.name: Stealth (State)
stats.summary: Grants stealth state, making the actor untargetable by most attacks until it acts or is revealed.

stats.name: Guard Blocked
stats.summary: Prevents this actor from being guarded, or from guarding others.

stats.name: Crit Received Chance
stats.summary: Modifies the chance this actor is CRIT by incoming attacks. Negative = crit-proof (better); positive = crit magnet.
stats.unit_note: Fractional chance modifier (0–1); negative is beneficial.

stats.name: Damage Reflect %
stats.summary: Reflects a percentage of received damage back to the attacker (thorns).

stats.name: Shard Reward %
stats.summary: Modifies shard (Crimson Court currency) reward. Positive = more shards.

stats.name: Shard Consume %
stats.summary: Modifies shard (Crimson Court currency) consumption. Negative = uses fewer shards.

stats.name: Cure Blight Chance (Self)
stats.summary: Per-turn chance to cure poison (blight) on self. Positive = shrugs off blight more often.

stats.name: Cure Bleed Chance (Self)
stats.summary: Per-turn chance to cure bleed on self. Positive = shrugs off bleed more often.

stats.name: Cure Blight Received Chance
stats.summary: Chance to cure poison (blight) when targeted by a cure from another actor. Positive = cures land better.

stats.name: Cure Bleed Received Chance
stats.summary: Chance to cure bleed when targeted by a cure from another actor. Positive = cures land better.

stats.name: Blight DoT Magnitude % (Dealt)
stats.summary: Modifies the MAGNITUDE of poison (blight) DoT this actor deals. Positive = stronger blight ticks.

stats.name: Blight DoT Magnitude % (Received)
stats.summary: Modifies the magnitude of poison (blight) DoT this actor RECEIVES. Negative = takes weaker blight (better).

stats.name: Blight DoT Duration % (Dealt)
stats.summary: Modifies the DURATION of poison (blight) DoT this actor applies. Positive = blight lasts longer.

stats.name: Blight DoT Duration % (Received)
stats.summary: Modifies the duration of poison (blight) DoT this actor receives. Negative = blight fades faster (better).

stats.name: Bleed DoT Magnitude % (Dealt)
stats.summary: Modifies the MAGNITUDE of bleed DoT this actor deals. Positive = stronger bleed ticks.

stats.name: Bleed DoT Magnitude % (Received)
stats.summary: Modifies the magnitude of bleed DoT this actor RECEIVES. Negative = takes weaker bleed (better).

stats.name: Bleed DoT Duration % (Dealt)
stats.summary: Modifies the DURATION of bleed DoT this actor applies. Positive = bleed lasts longer.

stats.name: Bleed DoT Duration % (Received)
stats.summary: Modifies the duration of bleed DoT this actor receives. Negative = bleed fades faster (better).

stats.name: Stress DoT Magnitude % (Dealt)
stats.summary: Modifies the MAGNITUDE of stress DoT this actor deals. Positive = stronger stress ticks.

stats.name: Stress DoT Magnitude % (Received)
stats.summary: Modifies the magnitude of stress DoT this actor RECEIVES. Negative = takes weaker stress DoT (better).

stats.name: Stress DoT Duration % (Dealt)
stats.summary: Modifies the DURATION of stress DoT this actor applies. Positive = stress DoT lasts longer.

stats.name: Stress DoT Duration % (Received)
stats.summary: Modifies the duration of stress DoT this actor receives. Negative = fades faster (better).

stats.name: Shuffle DoT Duration % (Dealt)
stats.summary: Modifies the DURATION of shuffle DoT this actor applies. Positive = shuffle lasts longer.

stats.name: Shuffle DoT Duration % (Received)
stats.summary: Modifies the duration of shuffle DoT this actor receives. Negative = fades faster (better).

stats.name: Heal DoT Magnitude % (Dealt)
stats.summary: Modifies the MAGNITUDE of heal-over-time (regen) this actor grants. Positive = stronger regen.

stats.name: Heal DoT Magnitude % (Received)
stats.summary: Modifies the magnitude of heal-over-time (regen) this actor receives. Positive = regen heals more.

stats.name: Heal DoT Duration % (Dealt)
stats.summary: Modifies the DURATION of heal-over-time (regen) this actor grants. Positive = regen lasts longer.

stats.name: Heal DoT Duration % (Received)
stats.summary: Modifies the duration of heal-over-time (regen) this actor receives. Positive = regen lasts longer on self.

stats.name: Torch Decrease %
stats.summary: Modifies the amount by which torch light is decreased by events/actions. Negative = light drops less (better for high-light play).

stats.name: Torch Increase %
stats.summary: Modifies the amount by which torch light is increased when refueled. Positive = torches restore more light.

stats.name: Ignore Stealth
stats.summary: Attacker-side flag: this actor's attacks can target and hit stealthed enemies.

stats.name: Transfer Buff From Attacker Chance
stats.summary: Chance to steal/transfer a buff from an attacker when hit. Positive = steals buffs more often.

stats.name: Transfer Debuff From Attacker Chance
stats.summary: Chance to transfer one of the actor's debuffs onto an attacker when hit. Positive = offloads debuffs more often.

stats.name: Random Friendly Target Chance
stats.summary: Chance a skill randomly targets a friendly instead of the intended target (confusion). Positive = more misdirection.

stats.name: Random Attack Retarget Chance
stats.summary: Chance an attack randomly retargets to a different enemy (confusion). Positive = more misdirection.

stats.name: Guard Duration % (Granted)
stats.summary: Modifies the duration of guard this actor GRANTS to others. Positive = guard lasts longer.

stats.name: Guard Duration % (Received)
stats.summary: Modifies the duration of guard this actor RECEIVES. Positive = stays guarded longer.

stats.name: Stress On Miss
stats.summary: Stress inflicted on this actor when it MISSES an attack. Positive amount = self-stress penalty on miss.

stats.name: Stress From Idle In Town
stats.summary: Stress gained by a hero while idle (benched) in town. Positive = accrues stress waiting around.

stats.name: Quirk-Tag Evolution Duration
stats.summary: Duration control for quirk-tag evolution (lifecycle flag).

stats.name: Deathblow Chance
stats.summary: Modifies deathblow chance (chance to be killed at 0 HP on Death's Door, or to land a killing blow). Sign/direction depends on context; negative deathblow-received is a survival buff.

stats.name: Heart-Attack Stress Heal %
stats.summary: Modifies stress-heal received in the Death's Door / heart-attack context (very high stress). Positive = better recovery from the brink.

stats.name: Riposte Duration %
stats.summary: Modifies the duration of riposte buffs this actor gets. Positive = riposte lasts longer.

stats.name: Buff Duration %
stats.summary: Modifies the duration of buffs this actor applies. Positive = buffs last longer.

stats.name: Ignore Guard
stats.summary: Attacker-side flag: this actor's attacks ignore guard redirection and hit the original target.

stats.name: Burn DoT (Grant)
stats.summary: Applies or modifies a burn damage-over-time on HP (Color of Madness DLC). Positive amount deals more HP loss per tick.
stats.unit_note: Raw HP lost per tick (per round).

stats.name: Burn DoT Magnitude % (Dealt)
stats.summary: Modifies the MAGNITUDE of burn DoT this actor deals. Positive = stronger burn ticks.

stats.name: Burn DoT Magnitude % (Received)
stats.summary: Modifies the magnitude of burn DoT this actor RECEIVES. Negative = takes weaker burn (better).

stats.name: Wildfire (Burn Spreads)
stats.summary: Burn spreads (wildfire) to adjacent targets. Flag that makes the actor's burn contagious.

stats.name: Burn DoT Decay %
stats.summary: Modifies the decay rate of burn DoT. Positive = burn fades faster; negative = burn lingers.

stats.name: Cure Burn Chance (Self)
stats.summary: Per-turn chance to cure burn on self. Positive = shrugs off burn more often.

stats.name: Cure Burn Received Chance
stats.summary: Chance to cure burn when targeted by a cure from another actor. Positive = cures land better.
